To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the matrix metalloproteinase-9 (MMP-9) expression is increased in the perivascular inflammatory cells of vasculitic peripheral neuropathies and is correlated with the CD8+ T cell density.

MMP-9 expression in vasculitic nerve biopsies correlates positively with immunostained CD8+ T lymphocytes and that MMP-9 immunoreactivity is more pronounced in nonsystemic than in systemic vasculitic peripheral neuropathy.
the expression pattern of MMP-9 in perivascular infiltrate is enhanced in vasculitic peripheral nerve tissue and correlates with CD8+ T cell infiltration.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of matrix metalloproteinsases in vasculitis neuropathy.
the expression and cellular source of MMP-9 in vasculitic peripheral neuropathy.
the expression pattern of matrix metalloproteases and the cellular source of MMPs in vasculitic polyneuropathy.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
MMPs are expressed in the perivascular inflammatory cells in vasculitis neuropathy.
MMP-9 is expressed in vasculitic nerve tissue, but its source is not clearly defined.
MMP-9 expression was increased in the vasculitic neuropaths, especially in nonsystemic vasulitic neuropathy, and that the source of this MMP-9 was CD8+ T cell.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

MMP-9 expression in perivascular infiltrate correlates with the degree of T cell infiltration in vasculitic nerve biopsies and is more pronounced in nonsystemic vasulitic neuropathy than in systemic vasculitic one.
MMPs, especially MMP-9, play an important role in vasculitic inflammatory neuropathy.
MMP-9 expression is increased in vasculitic peripheral nerve tissues, which is associated with CD8+ cell infiltration and is more prominent in NSVN.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the expression pattern of MMP-9 in vasculitic nerve tissues is different from that in other types of peripheral neuropathy.
MMP-9 is expressed by CD8+ T lymphocytes in vasculitic peripheral neuropathy and may be a potential target for treatment.
matrix metalloproteinase 9 expression is increased in perivneural inflammatory infiltrate in vasculitic nerve biopsies, and this increase is associated with the presence of CD8+ cells.
